{{Quote|You call these bugs? Back on Danos V, they got sting insects the size of a house.|An unidentified [[Scout/Legends|scout]]|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Sting insects''' could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danos V]]. The [[Insect/Legends|insects]] were large compared to other similar [[Species/Legends|species]] found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], growing up to the size of a house.<ref name="RPG" />
